title: Add core notes parser and renderer coverage
description: Extend CookbookCore tests for notes parsing, rendering normalization, duplicate heading handling, and parse-render-parse fixed-point behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover verbatim parsing of a `## Notes` block, empty Notes, duplicate Notes headings, and missing Notes.
Tests cover multi-paragraph notes and markdown markup surviving verbatim.
Tests cover renderer omission for empty notes and canonical insertion for non-empty notes.
At least one round-trip fixed-point test verifies mixed-markdown notes survive parse-render-parse unchanged.

handoff_summary.completed: Created Packages/CookbookCore/Tests/CookbookCoreTests/ShoppingListDocumentTests.swift with 12 tests in a @Suite("ShoppingListDocument Notes") struct. Tests verified to compile via `swift build --target CookbookCoreTests`.
handoff_summary.remaining: Test execution is the tester agent's responsibility.
handoff_summary.risks: Two existing tests in ShoppingListParserTests.swift (lines 82–97: preAisleContentPreservedAsNoteBlock and leadingAndTrailingBlankLinesStrippedFromNoteBlock) test pre-aisle content being stored in notes, but the current parser discards pre-aisle content and only captures from an explicit ## Notes heading. These tests are likely broken and will fail at test-run time. This is pre-existing from earlier bead work and outside this bead's scope.
handoff_summary.next_action: Run the CookbookCore test suite to verify all new tests pass and surface the two pre-existing broken tests in ShoppingListParserTests.swift.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListParserTests.swift lines 82–97 contain pre-existing tests that contradict the current parser behavior (pre-aisle content is discarded, not stored as notes). A tester or review agent should flag these for correction separately.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Created a new dedicated file ShoppingListDocumentTests.swift rather than extending ShoppingListParserTests.swift, as the bead's expected_files pointed to this new filename and the new tests cover combined parse+render+round-trip semantics rather than just parsing.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: 12 tests added: 6 parsing, 3 rendering, 3 fixed-point round-trip. All acceptance criteria met. mixedMarkdownNotesRoundTripIsFixedPoint covers bold, list items, and italic in a single notes block.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Tests for the tester to flag: preAisleContentPreservedAsNoteBlock and leadingAndTrailingBlankLinesStrippedFromNoteBlock in ShoppingListParserTests.swift are inconsistent with the current implementation and are expected to fail.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListParserTests.swift lines 82–97 contain pre-existing tests that contradict the current parser behavior (pre-aisle content is discarded, not stored as notes). A tester or review agent should flag these for correction separately.

execution_history.summary: Created ShoppingListDocumentTests.swift with 12 tests covering all acceptance criteria: verbatim ## Notes block parsing, empty/missing Notes, duplicate headings (first wins), multi-paragraph and markdown-markup survival, renderer omission for empty notes, canonical insertion for non-empty notes, and three round-trip fixed-point tests including one with mixed markdown. All 18 test-target files compile cleanly.
